name: digit-restaurant-pos-platform
description: Digit Restaurant POS web, Windows, and macOS desktop application
author: Digit POS

scripts.verify: npm run check:syntax && npm test && npm run build:client && npm run build:desktop-ui
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -k "cross-env PORT=5500 DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5432/restaurant_pos DATABASE_SSL=false npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev:client" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5500/api/health http://127.0.0.1:5400 && cross-env ELECTRON_START_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5400 DIGIT_DESKTOP_API_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5500/api DIGIT_DESKTOP_LAUNCH_BACKEND=false electron ."
scripts.desktop:seed: cross-env DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5432/restaurant_pos DATABASE_SSL=false npm run seed --workspace server
scripts.package:windows: npm run build:desktop-ui && electron-builder --win nsis portable --x64
scripts.release:windows: npm run verify && node scripts/release-preflight.cjs && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac: npm run build:desktop-ui && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dmg zip --universal
scripts.package:desktop: npm run build:desktop-ui && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --publish never
scripts.db:migrate: npm run db:migrate --workspace @pos/vendor-service && npm run db:migrate --workspace server
scripts.db:rollback: npm run db:rollback --workspace server && npm run db:rollback --workspace @pos/vendor-service
scripts.db:seed: npm run db:seed --workspace @pos/vendor-service && npm run db:seed --workspace server
scripts.db:status: npm run db:status --workspace @pos/vendor-service && npm run db:status --workspace server
scripts.db:migrate:documents: npm run db:migrate:documents --workspace @pos/vendor-service -- --execute && npm run db:migrate:documents --workspace server -- --execute
scripts.db:migrate:documents:dry-run: npm run db:migrate:documents --workspace @pos/vendor-service -- --dry-run && npm run db:migrate:documents --workspace server -- --dry-run
scripts.db:migrate:documents:verify: npm run db:migrate:documents --workspace @pos/vendor-service -- --verify && npm run db:migrate:documents --workspace server -- --verify
